AboutPage.title: About Manhattan Motors
AboutPage.body: We buy and sell quality used vehicles across Japan, based in Kariya, Aichi. Whether you want to sell your vehicle or find your next one, we make the process straightforward — honest appraisals, fair pricing, and full paperwork handled in Japan.
AboutPage.businessTypeValue: Used vehicle and machinery domestic sales
AboutPage.addressValue: 3-12-5 Hitotsugi-cho, Kariya City, Aichi Prefecture 448-0003, Japan

ServicesPage.title: What We Do
ServicesPage.subtitle: Straightforward vehicle buying and selling across Japan — based in Kariya, Aichi.
ServicesPage.sourcingDesc: We inspect and appraise your vehicle on-site at no cost to you. Honest assessment, no pressure, no obligation.
ServicesPage.documentationDesc: If you decide to sell, we make a fair market offer and process payment quickly. No complicated paperwork on your end.
ServicesPage.inspectionDesc: Every vehicle we stock is thoroughly inspected and serviced before going on sale. What you see is what you get.
ServicesPage.shippingDesc: Purchase directly from our lot in Kariya. We handle all Japanese registration transfer paperwork so you drive away without hassle.
ServicesPage.partsDesc: We also deal in forklifts, construction machinery, generators, and genuine auto parts — sourced from trusted local suppliers.
